pr_body:
This function was listed in the public sd-varlink.h header, but not actually made public. Fix that. It's quite useful, the comment in it describes the usecase nicely.

Fixes: #35554
pr_comments: I guess we should either drop the function from the header in v257-stable given it cannot be used, or add it to the 257 symbols group instead of the 258 one and backport this?

> I guess we should either drop the function from the header in v257-stable given it cannot be used, or add it to the 257 symbols group instead of the 258 one and backport this?

I'd drop it.

issue_context.title: sd-varlink.h declares nonexistent sd_varlink_reset_fds
issue_context.body: `sd-varlink.h` declares `int sd_varlink_reset_fds(sd_varlink *v);` but that function does not get defined anywhere. (There's a `static int varlink_reset_fds(sd_varlink *v)`, though.)

review_comments: Not something with this PR, but "see above" in comment should be "below", i.e. sd_varlink_error
